_meta.purpose: Maps every service to system stage, plan, purpose, deliverable, and measurable indicator (PRD Section 48, Step 2).
_meta.system_model: Discover -> Trust -> Convert -> Retain -> Repeat (PRD Section 4)
_meta.note: purpose and measurable_indicator are [extrapolated] — derived from the metrics already published per plan (impressions/CTR/sales-lift ranges) and the homepage's stated system logic, not from an internal ops sheet. Flag for sign-off before publishing verbatim, same as Step 1's audience/positioning fields.

services.name: Short-form video production
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Reach cold, genre-matched readers organically and generate the first trackable signal (who watched, how long, what they clicked) that every later stage depends on.
services.deliverable: 60-100+ videos/month depending on plan (60 Spark/Enhanced, 80 Foundation/Momentum, 100+ Starter/Growth), posted to TikTok, Shorts & Reels
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Impressions and video views (plan-scaled: 30k-70k impressions at Spark up to 120k-280k at Starter)

services.name: Cinematic book trailer / long-form video
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Give the content system a durable, reusable flagship asset — something that keeps working in ads, bios, and pitches instead of disappearing after one post cycle.
services.deliverable: 1 trailer (Foundation and Momentum via Foundation features), 1 trailer + long-form/avatar narration (Enhanced), 2 trailers (Starter), 2 trailers + theme song (Growth)
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Lift in video views and click-throughs versus the video-only tier below it (e.g. Enhanced's 10k-28k views vs. Spark's 5k-15k)

services.name: Original theme song
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Adds a distinct, ownable audio identity that content can reuse across every video, reinforcing recall across a high-volume posting cadence.
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Not independently tracked — rolls into the plan's overall impressions/CTR figures

services.name: Amazon DSP ad budget
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Layer paid amplification on top of organic content for authors ready to test ads without managing the ad account themselves.
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Incremental impressions/click-throughs attributable to paid vs. organic split

services.name: Listing copy & A+ content optimization
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Turn traffic the content sends into a credible, conversion-ready page — the listing has to earn the click before ARC reviews or retargeting can compound it.
services.deliverable: Foundation: base listing copy & A+ rewrite. Momentum: 'enhanced' A+ build. Growth: 'premium' A+ build.
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Click-through-to-listing conversion rate; sales lift attributable to listing changes isolated from content changes

services.name: ARC / review campaign
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Recruit genre-matched readers to generate honest reviews before paid/retargeted traffic arrives, so cold visitors see social proof rather than a blank listing.
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Net new reviews on the target title; review count delta pre/post campaign

services.name: Preorder listing setup
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Get the mechanical preorder infrastructure in place (listing configured, dates set) as a prerequisite for a later structured preorder push.

services.name: Preorder countdown campaign
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Convert warmed, trust-building traffic into a committed sale ahead of launch, using a fixed countdown window to create urgency.
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Preorders secured (plan-scaled: 80-180 at Momentum, 200-420 at Growth)

services.name: Reader list building (ShelfMates / StoryPals)
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Convert one-time viewers/buyers into an owned reader list the author keeps — not rented from a platform — giving a direct line for every future release.
services.deliverable: Ongoing enrollment of new readers via ShelfMates/StoryPals
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Net new reader-list signups/month; list growth rate

services.name: Newsletter feature placement
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Use the shared reader list to drive a free-promo push that both re-engages existing readers and pulls in new ones via download volume.
services.deliverable: 1 feature per quarter (Momentum), 1 feature per month (Growth)
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Free promo downloads per feature (plan-scaled: 1,200-2,400 at Momentum, 2,400-4,800 at Growth); KU page-reads boost

services.name: Full social media management
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Manage the author's own social presence (not just posting content) so retained readers have an active account to follow between releases.
services.deliverable: Full account management across the author's social channels
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Follower growth rate; engagement rate on owned-account posts

services.name: Segmented / lookalike audience retargeting
services.purpose: [extrapolated] Close the loop — show the book again to people who already engaged, moving passive awareness into a purchase, and extend reach to lookalike readers who match existing converters.
services.deliverable: Segmented retargeting, up to 5x daily for 30 days (both Momentum and Growth)
services.measurable_indicator: [extrapolated] Sales lift attributable to retargeted segment (plan-scaled: +25-45% at Momentum, +60-110% at Growth); KU page-reads boost

unmapped_or_flagged: Spark and Enhanced have no Trust, Convert, Retain, or Repeat stage services — they are Discover-only tiers. Confirm this is intentional messaging ("entry point," not a full system) before publishing plan comparisons.
Starter has Discover (paid) services only, no Trust/Convert/Retain/Repeat — this is intentional and must remain clear in public plan comparisons.
custom_tiers (Surge, Orbit) from pricing-data.json have no defined service scope yet — out of scope for this map until their commercial terms exist.
